name: MFDB Diagram - Management CMS & Admin Repos
description: Architecture map of Management_CMS and its integration within Admin Repos (/storage/emulated/0/Admin/Dev/Repos). Details the repository cluster, Flask application core, administrative services (Notes, Links, Todos), public CMS hosting layer, security and write-locking controls, sectional MFDB persistence (104a.mfdb.bejson), and the static HTML export pipeline.

shapes.label: Admin Repos Root
shapes.text:
/storage/emulated/0/Admin/Dev/Repos ($ADMIN_REPOS)
Central checkout domain for active BEJSON & Python projects.

shapes.label: CMS & Framework Repos
shapes.text:
Management_CMS, BEJSON_CMS, Experimental_CMS.
Modular Web_Framework scaffolds with per-section MFDB stores.

shapes.label: Core Libraries & Tooling
shapes.text:
BEJSON_104, BEJSON_105, MFDB_132_Compiler, CLI_AI.
Supplies foundational O(1) field cache and atomic storage.

shapes.label: Management_CMS Ingress
shapes.text:
Dev/Repos/Management_CMS
Unified administrative portal and public publishing microservice.

shapes.label: Flask Web Engine (app.py)
shapes.text: Core router binding administrative endpoints, CSRF/Token auth, and content controllers.

shapes.label: Admin Data Services
shapes.text: Categorized Notes, Links directory, and expandable Todo task management services.

shapes.label: Public CMS Content Layer
shapes.text: Pages, Posts, Categories, Navigation trees, and Media management via lib/Management_CMS.

shapes.label: Security & Atomic Mutex
shapes.text: Rate-limited admin token (0600), SVG download enforcement, and atomic file lock cycles.

shapes.label: Root MFDB (104a.mfdb.bejson)
shapes.text: Master database manifest linking TaxonomyType, ComponentMap, and SkeletonStore entities.

shapes.label: Sectional MFDB Stores
shapes.text: Content/Notes, Content/Page, Content/Post, Content/Tasks, Content/media data partitions.

shapes.label: Static Site Build (Export/)
shapes.text: Static compiler generating auto-TOC, related posts, clean sitemaps, 404, and compiled HTML.

territories.label: Zone 3: MFDB Persistence & Static Site Compiler
